source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of CLI applications (PDF 56).

blocks.text: Is hisse mein CLI (Command-Line Interface) applications ki baat hai. In mein user terminal ya command prompt par text commands likh kar program se kaam leta hai. CLI applications kai languages mein banti hain, Python bhi. Is chapter ki saari applications asal mein CLI applications hain aur command line se chalayi ja sakti hain. Aayiye 2.7.1 wali application command line se chalayein. Is ke qadam yeh hain:

items: main.py aur greetings.py dono files ek hi folder (directory) mein save karein.
Terminal ya command prompt kholein, cd se us folder mein jayein aur likhein: python main.py
Output aana chahiye: As - Salaam-Alaikum, everyone!

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Command line par folder badalne ke liye cd likhte hain, maslan cd Documents\python. Kitab "ran" chhapti hai; matlab "run" (chalayein) hai. Program tabhi chalega jab 2.7.1 wala function ka naam theek ho (say_salaam).

blocks.prompt: CLI application mein user program se kaise baat karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Terminal ya command prompt par text commands likh kar, maslan python main.py, aur jawab bhi text mein aata hai.

items: CLI: terminal mein text commands; python main.py se chalayein.
